mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.Description: Automate the fix for duplicate families or types
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.FullDescription: Copying types from duplicate families to main families, copying type parameter values, updating family instances, and deleting duplicate families. Replacing duplicate family types and deleting replaced types is also available
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.h6: Add a couple of families "Duplicate-Main family"
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.h8: Select the main family (into which the types will be copied)
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.h10: No matching families were found in the current category for which the selected family is a duplicate. An additional check is performed by type parameters – a pair of similar families should have the same type parameters
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.h11: Copy parameter values of replaced family instance
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.h12: Set family type from source family
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.h13: The list of main families displays families of the same category as the selected duplicate family, whose types are interchangeable. At the same time, the number and names of type parameters must be the same.
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.h18: The list contains only families with more than one type
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.m1: No types were selected in the list of processed families!
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.m3: Copying parameter values of frame type "{0}" from the family "{1}" to the family "{2}"
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.m4: Replacing the type for an instance of the family "{0}" {1}
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.m5: Replacing type "{0}" with type "{1}" in family "{2}"
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.e1: Type "{0}" was not created in the family "{1}"
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.e2: The family "{0}" could not be loaded into the document
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.e3: The parameter "{0}" was not found in the type "{1}" of the family "{2}"
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.e5: Failed to delete family "{0}" because instances of this family are present in the model
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.e6: Error while replacing type in family "{0}": {1}
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t1: Direction of processing: the family on the left is a duplicate, the family on the right is the main family
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t2: Add to the processing list a couple of families that did not match the standard duplicate search
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t3: New types will be created in the main family that are present and checked in the duplicate family and are absent in the main family
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t5: Duplicate family instances of checked types will be replaced with instances of the main family with the same type set. If an instance of the main family does not have the required type, the duplicate family instance will be skipped
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t6: Duplicate families that do not have instances in the model will be deleted
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t7: The instance parameters values will be copied from the replaced duplicate family to the replacement main family
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t8: The instances of the duplicate family are set to the types from the main family, which are selected in the dropdown lists
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t9: Add to the list families that did not match the standard search for duplicates
mprFamilyDuplicateFixer.t10: On the left side there are the types of the family, on the right – drop-down lists for replacing the type. If the type is not selected in the list, then replacement will not be performed
